posts.title: For sale: Clausing Kondia FV-1 CNC mill
posts.text: Selling my Clausing Kondia FV-1 CNC mill, because I stumbled into a newer Haas mill, and don't have space to keep both. It's in very good mechanical condition. - 220v single phase - 3hp spindle motor controlled by VFD - full simultaneous 3 axis CNC with 24" x 14" x 6" travels - Dynapath Delta 20 control - the control accepts drip feed of longer programs via rs-232, and it works well. posts.title: Kearney and Trecker (K&T) 2K Universal Milling Machine and Tooling for Sale - $3500
posts.text: This milling machine was made in about 1945 and is in pretty good shape. All the feeds and speeds work as does the rapid advance. It comes with a vertical head, both arbor supports, quite a few cutters, arbors, an ER40 collet arbor, a Van Norman swivel vise, two clamp sets, and a custom rolling dolly. Oil has been changed and the column filter is now an off the shelf item. The motor has been serviced at a motor shop (windings dipped and baked, new bearings) and the starter replaced and...
